title: Nine Miles of Water
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：canal　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 canal 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to dig ① a canal she could not cross, and she said the crossing was the whole of the lesson. The ② canal, meaning the channel and not the water, was nine miles long and was dug by whoever came last; a canal, she said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ canal in that valley had the same lock, and the ④ canal at the north, meaning the one the engineer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever dug properly. A canal, my grandmother said, is nine parts labour and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the labour is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ canal was the whole of the trade, meaning the trade it carried and not the channel. The ⑥ canal, meaning the trade and not any of that, is the only thing in a country that everybody uses and nobody questions; a canal, he said, is either something you dig or the only word that means both a channel and a trade. She said the trade is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ canal had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the lock. The ⑧ canal of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine miles and eleven years of digging; a canal, she said, is either the one at the north or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ canal I remember is the one at the north, which was reopened in 1970 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ canal, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being used; every canal, she said, is a trade that has agreed to look like a channel. She said the trade was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 运河（指那条水道本身，与水相对）
C. 固定搭配：dig a canal 开凿一条运河
D. n. 运河（指山谷里每一条）
E. n. 运河（指北面那一条）
F. n. 运河（抽象：它承载的那些贸易）
G. n. 那些贸易（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a canal she could not cross
The canal, meaning the channel and not the water
canal was the whole of the trade
the canal had become a photograph in a report
The canal of the whole thing
A canal, my grandmother said in 1975

answers.why: dig a canal 意为“开凿一条运河”，1946 年母亲被派去开凿一条她渡不过去的运河。
canal 意为“运河”，指那条水道本身而不是水，长九英里，由最后走的人开挖。
canal 指山谷里每一条运河，每一条都是同样的船闸。
canal 指北面那一条（工程师管的那一条），是唯一有人认真开凿过的。
canal 意为“运河”，抽象指它承载的那些贸易，父亲说 canal 就是那些贸易的全部。
canal 为抽象用法，指那些贸易本身，是全国人人都用、却没人质疑的东西。
canal 意为“运河、沟渠”，到 1964 年这条 canal 成了报告里的一张照片。
canal 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英里和十一年的开挖。
canal 意为“运河”，我记得的是北面那一条，1970 年重新通航，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
canal 为抽象总称，祖母说运河是唯一会因为被使用而变好的东西。

那条运河，指的是那条水道本身而不是水，长九英里，由最后走的人开挖。（canal）

父亲说 canal 就是那些贸易的全部，指的是贸易本身而不是水道。（canal）
1975 年祖母说，运河是唯一会因为被使用而变好的东西。（canal）
answers: In 1946 my mother was sent to dig a canal she could not cross, and she said the crossing was the whole of the lesson.
The canal, meaning the channel and not the water, was nine miles long and was dug by whoever came last.
Every canal in that valley had the same lock.
The canal at the north, meaning the one the engineer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever dug properly.
My father said canal was the whole of the trade, meaning the trade it carried and not the channel.
A canal, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being used.
